newsitem.title: AZERBAIJAN: SOCCER-KARABAKH WIN AZERI EUROPEAN CUP PLACE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KARABAKH WIN AZERI EUROPEAN CUP PLACE.

text.p: Azerbaijan's Karabakh Agdam, whose home city was destroyed in the Nagorno-Karabakh war, secured the country's place in the Champions' League at the weekend under a new system that combines clubs' senior and youth team results.

Azeri soccer officials said on Monday that the better performance of Karabakh's youth teams meant that Neftchi Baku, whose senior team won the league title last week, only finished second under the "club championship" aggregate system.
Introduced this season, the system is designed to promote youth soccer. Neftchi will play in the UEFA Cup.

Karabakh have been unable to play at home since 1993, when they last won the league title. In the summer of that year, mainly Moslem Agdam was overrun by Christian Armenian forces consolidating their hold on the disputed nearby region of Nagorno-Karabakh.
The city of 100,000 has become a ghost town.
